findings.text: migrate_device_pages provides outward migration completion over source and destination pfn arrays with count, delegating to internal helper with absent migration context.
split_huge_pmd_address offers address directed huge page table split that locates page middle directory for owning address space and no-ops when absent before invoking inner split with freeze choice.
mm_find_pmd resolves page middle directory by descending global then fourth then upper then middle levels and returns null unless each upper level is present.

migrate_device_unmap drains lookaside caches then scans source array advancing by folio span, marking multi page folios compound, isolating reclaimable folios from least recently used lists once draining globally on first miss, attempting unmap, validating exclusivity, counting successes and restoring migration entries plus locks and references for failures.

migrate_vma_check_page accepts a candidate only when references beyond map count stay within allowance for collector hold plus fault page coincidence plus zone device surcharge plus address space presence plus private data.

Inner device migration clears migrate request when destination absent, and for absent source with migrate request expects migration context, opens single ownership scoped invalidation range on first need, derives span from compound marking, reasserts migrate and inserts destination per subpage.

When transparent huge migration is supported the inner routine handles size mismatch by splitting an unmapped compound source to single pages when destination is small or by dropping migrate when destination is compound while source is small, with split failure also dropping migrate and compound.
Migration toward device private or coherent requires anonymous source without retained swap cache when a mapping exists, while any other zone device destination is rejected outright.

For present source and destination the inner routine refreshes mapping after swap cache release, accounts fault page extra hold, migrates mapping per subpage clearing migrate on error and propagating flags on success, then closes notifier range if opened.
folio_migrate_mapping computes expected references as folio expectation plus caller extra plus one and returns retry error unless observed count matches before delegating to inner mapping transfer.

Compound aware split helper holds an extra folio reference across address directed huge split with freeze, invokes unmapped folio split to order zero, clears compound on indexed source entry and replicates address derived entries for remaining huge subpages preserving low flag bits.
Alternate build of compound aware split helper is a no-op success that leaves migration state unchanged.
Page span helper reports one unless compound marking is present, in which case supporting builds report huge page middle directory span while other builds warn.
folio_split_unmapped requires unmapped locked large anonymous state, rejects when references exceed expectation plus one, and performs freeze and split with interrupts disabled targeting order zero.

Freeze and split coordinator optionally guards deferred split queue under read copy update, freezes references to cache count plus one, detaches deferred queue and adjusts partial mapping statistics, adjusts transparent huge statistics for file or swap backed mappings crossing middle directory threshold, acquires swap cluster for swap cache, optionally locks reclaim vector, splits, then unfreezes tail folios before head and releases locks.

After split each successor beyond head invokes device private callback, unfreezes to its own cache count plus one, joins reclaim handling, replaces swap cache entry when clustered, is skipped for anonymous without mapping, is stored into page cache when index precedes end, otherwise is dropped beyond end of file with shmem accounting or dirty clearance and cache removal plus reference release.
Cache reference baseline is zero for anonymous folios outside swap cache and equals page count otherwise.

Unmapped splitter walks orders downward from uniform target or from one below old order, skips order one for anonymous, prepares extended array split with preallocated or fallible path, duplicates memory control references and ownership and allocation tags, performs order step, updates anonymous statistics, then continues on folio containing split point.

Order splitter clears and rescans hardware poison, clones a defined subset of status flags plus mapping plus index plus swap offset plus memory control plus last processor hints to each new head, enforces visibility before clearing tail state, prepares compound state for nonzero target, scans poison per range and propagates youth and idleness, then records new order or clears compound for order zero.
Poison scan reports true if any page in contiguous range carries hardware poison, else false.
Order setter warns and leaves state unchanged for zero order or non large folio or oversized order, otherwise stores low byte order and when configured updates cached page count as power of two.

Reclaim vector lock must be held when adding split successor; device private heads bypass list work, reclaim path with supplied list links successor with extra reference and expects head off list, normal path expects head on list and queues successor beside head and marks it resident, clearing lock count for unevictable heads.

Freeze and split serializes deferred queue with list lock under read copy update, freezes references before list and swap cluster and reclaim vector changes, disables interrupts across whole operation in unmapped split wrapper, and requires caller locked folio.

Device unmap holds folio locks from collection through migration decision, unlocks every restored folio except fault folio which stays locked for caller, and balances isolate and collect references with paired get and put operations around putback.

Source entries transition from requested migrate to cleared on destination absence or validation failure or mapping error or unsupported target or split failure, gain compound when spanning multiple pages and lose it after split or mismatch handling, while empty destination handling reasserts migrate before insertion.

Reference mismatch during mapping migration or folio split yields retryable busy status rather than partial transfer, and nonuniform extended array allocation failure aborts split with propagated error.

Writeback folio entering device migration, missing migration context when inserting for absent source, and private data on tail pages are treated as programming faults via bug or warn checks, alongside mapped or unlocked or non large or non anonymous split requests.

Migration context exposes start and end addresses, owning virtual area, source array, fault page pointer and notifier owner, used for address computation, range notification and extra reference accounting.

Split logic observes and mutates folio mapping and index, swap value, private overlap, memory control data, least recently used linkage, deferred list, order storage, page count cache, last processor id, youth idleness and poison and large remappable markers.
Source and destination arrays encode page frame numbers with low bit flags for migrate request and compound span plus shift defining frame field width.
Huge page geometry constants define middle directory page count and order threshold used for span derivation, array expansion and statistics transitions.
Maximum folio order bounds order setting and split hierarchy.
